title: Microring resonator with bus coupler and integrated heater
summary: Design a microring resonator coupled to a straight bus waveguide via an integrated directional coupler region, with an integrated heater for thermal tuning of the ring resonance.

blocks.role: Microring resonator (ring + bus coupler) with integrated heater
blocks.notes: Single ring resonator side-coupled to a bus waveguide (directional coupler/evanescent coupling region). Include an integrated heater over/near the ring for thermo-optic tuning; heater details (material/stack, resistance target, contact pads, keepouts) to be specified by PDK. Provide optical ports on the bus waveguide (through and drop optional; if add-drop, include a second bus waveguide).

wiring_notes: Expose optical IO on the bus waveguide ends (at least 2 ports: input and through).
If an add-drop configuration is desired, route a second bus waveguide to create a drop port pair (total 4 optical ports).
Provide electrical connectivity to the integrated heater via metal routing to bond pads; ensure optical-metal spacing/keepouts per PDK DRC.

objective.target_behavior: Thermally tunable microring resonance filter: light couples from bus into ring at resonance; heater shifts resonance wavelength via thermo-optic effect.
